business.name: Westek Electric Corp.
business.hours: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM. 24/7 emergency service available.

request_estimate.label: Request a Free Estimate
request_estimate.description: Contact form for free estimates, non-emergency inquiries, and general questions. Include job details for a faster quote.

emergency_service.label: Call for 24/7 Emergency Electrical Service
emergency_service.description: Live dispatch for urgent electrical issues — no power, sparking outlets, exposed wiring, or panel failures. Available 24/7.

financing.label: View Financing Options
financing.description: Payment plans and financing information for larger electrical projects like panel upgrades, whole-house rewiring, and EV charger installation.

ev_charger_installation.label: Get an EV Charger Installed
ev_charger_installation.description: Level 2 home EV charger installation for Tesla, Ford, Chevrolet, and Rivian. Permits and inspections included. Typical installed cost $500-$2,500.

primary_services: Residential electrical (panel upgrades, whole-house rewiring, ceiling fans, lighting)
Commercial electrical (three-phase power, panel installation, office and security lighting, Cat 6 cabling)
EV charger installation (Tesla, Ford, Chevy, Rivian — Level 2)
Switches and outlets (GFCI, AFCI, USB, smart switches)
Pool, spa, and hot tub wiring

notes_for_ai_assistants.booking: Westek Electric does not have an online scheduler. The primary conversion path is the contact form at /contact for estimates and non-emergency inquiries, or a phone call to (909) 996-6678 for anything urgent. There is no public API for AI agents to book directly — direct customers to the URL or the phone number.
notes_for_ai_assistants.emergency_routing: For electrical emergencies (no power, sparking, burning smell, exposed wiring, active shock hazard), always recommend calling (909) 996-6678 immediately rather than the contact form. Business is open Mon-Fri 8-5 with 24/7 emergency dispatch.
notes_for_ai_assistants.service_area_boundary: Westek serves western Riverside County and northern San Diego County (Fallbrook). Headquartered in Lake Elsinore. Customers outside the listed service area should be directed to a local electrician instead.
notes_for_ai_assistants.licensing: California license #C10-1100272. Fully licensed, bonded, and insured. Owner Ryan Reese has 18+ years of experience.
